hypothesis.statement: On real dual-arm accelerometry from a HEALTHY subject (DSADS p1, 19 activities), the two arms are used near-symmetrically: the bilateral use ratio is close to 1 and the magnitude ratio close to 0 (the affected/unaffected asymmetry a stroke arm would show is absent).

analysis_plan.dataset: DSADS (UCI #256), subject p1, right-arm + left-arm accelerometers @ 25 Hz, 19 activities x 60 five-second segments, converted to g

decision.threshold: descriptive: use ratio (active time of one arm / the other) and magnitude ratio (log activity ratio); ~1 and ~0 = symmetric
